Package com.ceichhorst.reservation.controller

Class ConfirmationServlet

  • java.lang.Object
    • jakarta.servlet.GenericServlet
      • jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet
        • com.ceichhorst.reservation.controller.ConfirmationServlet
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    jakarta.servlet.Servlet, jakarta.servlet.ServletConfig, Serializable
    @WebServlet("/confirm-reservation")
public class ConfirmationServlet
extends jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet
    Servlet responsible for confirming and finalizing customer reservations.

    This servlet represents the final step in the reservation workflow. It processes form data submitted by the user, validates inputs, and delegates reservation creation to ReservationService.

    Responsibilities:

    • Validate user-submitted reservation details
    • Ensure session state is valid (restaurant context)
    • Delegate reservation creation to the service layer
    • Handle success and failure outcomes
    • Forward to confirmation or return to input form as needed

    Flow:

    1. User submits reservation details form
    2. Servlet validates required fields and input formats
    3. ReservationService attempts to create the reservation
    4. On success → forward to confirmation page
    5. On failure → return to form with error message

    This servlet relies on ReservationResult to distinguish between successful and failed reservation attempts without using exceptions for expected business outcomes (e.g., full capacity).

    • Method Detail

      • doPost

        protected void doPost​(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest request,
                      jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse response)
               throws jakarta.servlet.ServletException,
                      IOException
        Handles HTTP POST requests to finalize a reservation.

        This method performs the following steps:

        1. Validates session state to ensure a restaurant context exists
        2. Extracts and validates request parameters
        3. Converts input values to appropriate types
        4. Delegates reservation creation to ReservationService
        5. Handles success or failure outcomes
        6. Forwards to the appropriate JSP view

        Required request parameters:

        • customerName
        • email
        • reservationDate (ISO-8601 format, yyyy-MM-dd)
        • reservationTime (ISO-8601 format, HH:mm)
        • partySize
        • restaurantId

        Optional parameters:

        • guestAllergies
        • guestNotes

        Success behavior:

        • Sets confirmation details as request attributes
        • Forwards to /WEB-INF/confirm-reservation.jsp

        Failure behavior:

        • Sets error message and preserves user input
        • Forwards back to /WEB-INF/reservation-details.jsp
        Overrides:
        doPost in class jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet
        Parameters:
        request - the HTTP request containing form data
        response - the HTTP response
        Throws:
        jakarta.servlet.ServletException - if processing fails
        IOException - if an I/O error occurs
